Infernal Dust.name: infernal dust
Infernal Dust.desc: The remains of an abyssal tether to this plane, banished or slain. Best handled with gloves.

Solar Dust.name: solar dust
Solar Dust.desc: A pinch of Astrata worked into radiant matter. Looking at it hurts your eyes.

Alchemical Ozium.name: alchemical ozium
Alchemical Ozium.desc: Alchemical processing has left it unfit for consumption.

Berry Powder.name: berry powder
Berry Powder.desc: Berries ground and dried into a soft fragrant powder.

Mineral Dusts.name: mineral dusts
Mineral Dusts.desc: Elements of gems ground and sifted of impurities to help draw out its useful alchemical minerals.

Troll Horn.name: troll horn
Troll Horn.desc: The horn of a bog troll.

Tail Bone.name: tail bone
Tail Bone.desc: The only bone in creachers with alchemical properties.

Rosa.name: rosa
Rosa.desc: It is said that these were white - until Graggar bled on its fields.

Stone Dust.name: stone dust
Stone Dust.desc: Finely ground mineral dust used for glass clay refinement.

Purified Salts.name: purified salts
Purified Salts.desc: Salts that have been finely sifted to enhance their healing properties and to bolster their connection to the arcyne.

Alchemical Mortar.name: alchemical mortar
Alchemical Mortar.desc: A small, thick-walled stone bowl made for grinding things up inside.

Sugar.name: sugar
Sugar.desc: Milled sugarcane, sweet as can be.

Roast Coffee Beans.name: roasted coffee beans
Roast Coffee Beans.desc: Roasted coffee beans, with a much deeper flavor. Can be used to brew coffee. The variant grown in these lands can be brewed without being ground.

Ground Tea Leaves.name: ground tea leaves
Ground Tea Leaves.desc: Ground tea leaves that can be used to brew tea, or further combined with pumpkin spice.

Dried Rosa Petals.name: dried rosa petals
Dried Rosa Petals.desc: Dried rosa petals, fit for brewing a delicious tea with humor-balancing properties. Combining it with some pumpkin spice should help to elevate its fragrance even more.

Dough.desc: The triumph of all bakers. Smother with butter, roll it flat with a rolling pin, speckle it with apples and raisins.. the possibilities are truly endless!
Dough.name: dough

FlatDough.desc: Flattened dough, bare for all to see. A sharp edge can prepare the lines for a sheet of crackerdough, while a smearing of tomatoes can set the stage for a peasant's feast.
FlatDough.name: flatdough

Small Butter Dough.desc: A slice of pedigree, to create lines of history.
Small Butter Dough.name: butterdough piece

Dotted Tartdough.desc: A hollow bowl that has yet to show its fullest potential.
Dotted Tartdough.name: dotted tartdough

Tallow.name: tallow
Tallow.desc: Fatty tissue is harvested from slain creachurs and rendered of its membraneous sinew to produce a hard shelf-stable grease.

Fish Mince.desc: Meat sliced many times both with and against the grain, producing a fine mince.
Fish Mince.name: minced fish

Meat Mince.desc: Meat sliced many times both with and against the grain, producing a fine mince.
Meat Mince.name: minced meat

Garlick clove.desc: A clove of garlick, fit for stewage. Don't eat this.
Garlick clove.name: garlick clove

Shellfish.desc: Meat from a crustacean. Salty with a different texture than most fishmeat. Chop to create mince, bake or fry to make fried shellfish meat
Shellfish.name: shellfish meat

Crabmeat.desc: A chunk of raw crab meat, absolutely wonderful.
Crabmeat.name: crab meat

Apple Slice.desc: A neatly sliced bit of apple. Nicer to eat. Refined, even.
Apple Slice.name: apple slice

Sausage.desc: Delicious flesh stuffed in a intestine casing.
Sausage.name: sausage

Salo.name: salo
Salo.desc: Salted pork fat, slabbed and ready for a slicing. A classic amongst the peasantry's pantry, when leaner cuts of meat are scarce. Quite delicious if watered down.

Salumoi.desc: A salted sausage, said to last for ten yils before spoiling. As the legend goes, dwarven caravans used this 'travel food' to create the first sandwich: a slice of bread, crowned with this sliceable meat.
Salumoi.name: salumoi

Coppiette.desc: Dried mincesticks, prepared similarly to saloumi. While tougher to chew, it's certainly not as dry or firm as hardtack.
Coppiette.name: coppiette

Raisins.desc: Jackberries that've been pruned of their juiciness, and turned into flavorful nuggets. Like the humble hardtack, so too will these raisins outlast their creators.  When combined with honey and doused in a pot of boiling fat, it can birth 'sweetglass'; a shatteringly sweet candy, popular amongst the elders and children-of-nobility.
Raisins.name: raisins

Brothbrique.desc: A melding of dried meat, berries, and tallow that has fueled Psydonia's expeditioneers for centuries. It is denser - and arguably less appetizing - than most foodstuffs, but consequently unrivaled in terms of sheer nutritional mirth. Traditionally sliced and dropped into boiling water, in order to make a quick-yet-robust broth.
Brothbrique.name: brothbrique

Raisin Bread.desc: A popular dessert amongst the peasantry, this loaf of sweetbread's speckled with fruity surprises. In recent years, it has more palettes amongst the papacy: t'was Rockhill's abbey that christened a variant, glazed with a sugary veneer.
Raisin Bread.name: raisin loaf

Raisin Biscuit.desc: A crispy buttery pastry with chewy raisins inside.
Raisin Biscuit.name: raisin biscuit

Hardtack.desc: Brittle and hard, like chewing on a rock. These salted biscuits will never expire, however: and for those who travel across Psydonia, that fact alone earns it a space in their packs.
Hardtack.name: hardtack

Bread.desc: One of Psydonia's staple foodstuffs, made from leavened dough. From the pauper to the papal, none can deny the simplistic beauty of a freshly-baked loaf.
Bread.name: bread loaf

Bun.desc: Portable, quaint, and entirely consumable - for the discerning traveler. It yearns to be further dolled with a sausage, wedge of cheese, or some delicious jams.
Bun.name: bun

Cross Bun.desc: Traditionally eaten for breakfast amongst Psydonia's abbeys. Astratans in particular have made it a practice to add a slice of marmalade to their crossbuns, in reverance of Her golden authority.
Cross Bun.name: crossbun

Psycross Bun.desc: How long will you endure the temptation to eat it? Surely, you wouldn't dare to jam it up as well, would you.. ?
Psycross Bun.name: psycrossbun

Prezzel (Requires Dwarf).desc: The next best thing after sliced bread. The recipe is a closely guarded secret among the dwarves. So dire is their conviction that not even the Inquisition's most agonizing methods could force them to reveal it.
Prezzel (Requires Dwarf).name: prezzel

Handpie(Berry).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Berry).name: berry handpie

Handpie( Poison Berry).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie( Poison Berry).name: berry handpie

Handpie(Mince).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Mince).name: meat handpie

Handpie(Truffle).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Truffle).name: handpie

Handpie(Potato).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Potato).name: potato handpie

Handpie(Fish).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Fish).name: fish handpie

Handpie(Crab).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Crab).name: crab handpie

Handpie(Cabbage).desc: The dwarves call this 'pierogi' in their dialect. It'll stay fresh for a good long while until the crust is bitten.
Handpie(Cabbage).name: cabbage handpie

Pie(Fish).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with fresh fish. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Fish).name: fish pie

Pie(Pot).desc: A delicious, homemade pie. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Pot).name: pot pie

Pie(Crab).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with the inside of a crustacean. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Crab).name: crab pie

Pie(Berry).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with wild berries. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Berry).name: berry pie

Pie(Poison Berry).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with wild berries. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Poison Berry).name: berry pie

Pie(Apple).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with the sliced apples. Still needs to be cut.
Pie(Apple).name: apple pie

Pie(Pumpkin).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with pumpkin and cheese. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Pumpkin).name: pumpkin pie

Dot Tart with Tangerines.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed tangerines, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes. </br>'If we're kind and polite, the world will be right.'
Dot Tart with Tangerines.name: tangerine dot tart

Dot Tart with Plums.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed plums, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes.
Dot Tart with Plums.name: plum dot tart

Dot Tart with Blackberries.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed blackberries, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes. </br>'I did it for me. I liked it.. I was good at it. And I felt.. alive.'
Dot Tart with Blackberries.name: blackberry dot tart

Dot Tart with Raspberries.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed raspberries, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes.
Dot Tart with Raspberries.name: raspberry dot tart

Dot Tart with Strawberries.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed strawberries, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes.
Dot Tart with Strawberries.name: strawberry dot tart

Dot Tart with Pears.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed pears, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes.
Dot Tart with Pears.name: pear dot tart

Dot Tart with Apples.desc: A small pastry filled with jammed apples, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes.
Dot Tart with Apples.name: apple dot tart

Dot Tart with Ambrosia.desc: A small pastry filled with the jam of a divine fruit, for when a whole pie would be inappropiate for canapes. </br>'Why must the most forbidden fruits taste the sweetest?'
Dot Tart with Ambrosia.name: ambrosia dot tart

Fresh Cheese.desc: Clotted and salted milk, eager to be cocooned in cloth so that it may realize its fullest potential.
Fresh Cheese.name: fresh cheese

Cheese Wheel.desc: A hunk of burning love, aching to age.
Cheese Wheel.name: wheel of cheese

Aged Cheese Wheel.desc: A hunk of smoldering love, aged to perfection.
Aged Cheese Wheel.name: wheel of aged cheese

Butter.name: stick of butter
Butter.desc: Delicious fattiness, fit for elevating meals-a-plenty.

Cake Base.desc: With this sweet thing, you shall make them sing.
Cake Base.name: cake base

Ranesheni(Zybantine) Cake.desc: Cake glazed with honey in the famous Zybantine fashion for a delicious sweet treat.
Ranesheni(Zybantine) Cake.name: zybantine cake

Frosting.desc: Butter mixed with sugar and whipped into a delicious frosting.
Frosting.name: frosting

Frosted Cake.desc: Cake glazed with a sugary frosting, ready to be decorated or enjoyed.
Frosted Cake.name: frosted cake

Apple Cake.desc: Cake glazed with a sugary frosting and layered with juicy apples, sweetness and tart.
Apple Cake.name: apple cake

Berry Cake.desc: Cake with a spread of juicy berries dripping into its frosting. Often found paired with antidote.
Berry Cake.name: berry cake

Berry (poison) Cake.desc: Cake with a spread of juicy berries dripping into its frosting. Often found paired with antidote.
Berry (poison) Cake.name: berry cake

Blackberry Cake.desc: A dark frosted cake topped with blackberries. A fruity treat often paired with raspberry cake.
Blackberry Cake.name: blackberry cake

Carrot Cake.desc: A surprisingly sweet frosted cake with cooked carrot peels stuffed in its tender interior.
Carrot Cake.name: carrot cake

Lemon Cake.desc: A frosted cake with a rich citrus taste. A thick layer of lemon filling give it a sweet, tangy and zesty flavour.
Lemon Cake.name: lemon cake

Lime Cake.desc: A frosted cake with a rich citrus taste. A thick layer of lime filling give it a sweet, tangy and zesty flavour.
Lime Cake.name: lime cake

Mentha Cake.desc: A frosted cake with the fresh taste of mentha and the wyld forests.
Mentha Cake.name: mentha cake

Peace Cake.desc: Imbued with the miraculous powers of its decorative bud, a frosted cake said to be shared between lovers or after mourning.
Peace Cake.name: peace cake

Raspberry Cake.desc: A frosted cake topped with beautiful raspberries. A fruity treat often paired with blackberry cake.
Raspberry Cake.name: raspberry cake

Strawberry Cake.desc: Sweetened strawberries and strawberry filling over a tender frosted cake, simple and elegant.
Strawberry Cake.name: strawberry cake

Tangerine Cake.desc: A frosted cake with a rich citrus taste. A thick layer of tangerine filling give it a sweet, tangy and zesty flavour.
Tangerine Cake.name: tangerine cake

Rocknut Cake.desc: A simple frosted cake with a spread of nuts. Its mild stimulant properties makes-up most of its popularity.
Rocknut Cake.name: rocknut cake

Applenut Cake.desc: Frosted cake layered with apples and surrounded in nuts. A spectacle of flavors and textures, with mild stimulant properties.
Applenut Cake.name: applenut cake

Toast.desc: Crisp and crunchy, yet not burnt - truly, an alchemical wonder. Best enjoyed with a fried egg, a knob of sliced butter, or some freshly-prepared jams.
Toast.name: toast

Breadcrumbs.desc: Perfect for adding some crunch to deep-fried food.
Breadcrumbs.name: toast crumbs

Buttered Toast.desc: Crisp and crunchy, yet not burnt - truly, an alchemical wonder. Now slathered with a healthy layer of butter.
Buttered Toast.name: buttered toast

Salumoi bread.desc: A piece of toast with a thin slice of salumoi on top. Often eaten by soldiers on the march. Salty!
Salumoi bread.name: salumoi bread

Cheese bread.desc: A slice of toast with a rather thin wedge of cheese melted into the crust.
Cheese bread.name: cheese bread

Egg toast.desc: A piece of toast with a fried egg on top that jiggles gently when prodded.
Egg toast.name: egg toast

Salo bread.desc: The salo's smooth consistency helps soften the rough grainy bread.
Salo bread.name: salo bread

Bacon bread.desc: A slice of bread with crispy bacon on top for the perfect breakfast.
Bacon bread.name: bacon bread

Fresh Cheese Bun.desc: A quaint treat from the Grenzelhoftian kitchens.
Fresh Cheese Bun.name: fresh cheese bun

Grenzel Bun.desc: The classic wiener in a bun, now a staple of Grenzelhoft cuisine. It is rumored that elves first invented it long ago, back when they practiced the consumption of other people...
Grenzel Bun.name: grenzelbun

Raston.desc: A slice of cheese melted between two lightly-toasted buns.
Raston.name: raston

Pastry.desc: Crispy, buttery, and delightfully flaky. A favorite treat among children and sweetlovers.
Pastry.name: pastry

Frybread.desc: Flatbread fried with butter until crispy. A staple of the elven kitchen.
Frybread.name: frybread

Fried Egg.desc: Some Astratans enjoy their eggs sunny-side up.
Fried Egg.name: fried egg

Rice and Beef Meal.desc: Rice mixed with beef steak and carrots.
Rice and Beef Meal.name: rice and beef meal

Rice and Pork Meal.desc: Rice mixed with fatty pork and fresh cucumbers.
Rice and Pork Meal.name: rice and pork meal

Rice and Shrimp Meal.desc: Rice mixed with shrimp and carrots.
Rice and Shrimp Meal.name: rice and shrimp meal

Rice and Frybird Meal.desc: Rice mixed with frybird and carrots.
Rice and Frybird Meal.name: rice and frybird meal

Rice with Egg and Cheese.desc: Rice mixed with an egg and layered with melted cheese.
Rice with Egg and Cheese.name: rice with egg and cheese

Twin Fried Egg.desc: Double the yolks, double the fun.
Twin Fried Egg.name: twin fried egg

Hammerholdian breakfast.desc: A classic of the northern fortresses, peeled of its more exotic ingredients for Ferentian kitchens, a true staple of Dwarven diet.
Hammerholdian breakfast.name: Hammerholdian breakfast

Valerian Omelette.desc: Fried eggs on a bed of half-melted cheese. A dish from distant lands.
Valerian Omelette.name: valerian omelette

Bacon and Egg.desc: Fried eggs with bacon. The bacon's savory salty crunch is a perfect complement to the eggs' more mellow flavors.
Bacon and Egg.name: bacon and egg

Stuffed Egg.desc: Egg stuffed with a creamy cheese filling.
Stuffed Egg.name: stuffed egg

Peppersteak.desc: Roasted meat flanked with a generous coating of ground pepper for intense flavor.
Peppersteak.name: peppersteak

Ducal Steak.desc: Roasted meat flanked with a generous coating of ground pepper for intense flavor and scribbled in with garlick. Said to have been favorite meal of the Mad Duke.
Ducal Steak.name: ducal steak

Wiener on Cabbage.desc: A rich and hearty meal, perfect for a soldier on the march.
Wiener on Cabbage.name: wiener on cabbage

Frybird With Tato.desc: Hearty, comforting, and rich - Some say it was Ravox's favorite meal.
Frybird With Tato.name: frybird with a tato

Spiced Bird Roast.desc: A plump bird, roasted perfection, spiced to taste divine.
Spiced Bird Roast.name: spiced bird-roast

Crab Cake.desc: A variant of the handpie filled with buttery, savory shellfish meat and made with a buttered slice of dough.
Crab Cake.name: crab cake

Saint Dendor's Salmon.desc: A dish invented in Otava, of a green sauce of fat and herbs atop salmon.
Saint Dendor's Salmon.name: saint dendor's salmon

Berrymash Salmon.desc: A dish of jacksberries mashed atop peppered salmon. Hearty.
Berrymash Salmon.name: berrymash salmon

Peppertail.desc: A sprinkle of pepper atop the tail of a cretinous beast, meant to make it palatable for more than peasantry.
Peppertail.name: peppertail

Buttered Lobster.desc: A lobster, covered in butter. Delicious!
Buttered Lobster.name: buttered lobster

Buttered Sole.desc: A slab of sole, buttered and crispy at the edges.
Buttered Sole.name: buttered sole

Plaice with Onion.desc: A slab of plaice with fried onion. Delicious!
Plaice with Onion.name: plaice with onion

Alecod.desc: Cod with ale poured over it right after cooking. A... choice pick.
Alecod.name: alecod

Milkclams.desc: Clams, simmered in milk... How queer.
Milkclams.name: milkclams

Garlicked Seabass.desc: Seabass, with cloves of garlick smothered onto it. Delicious.
Garlicked Seabass.name: garlicked seabass

Jellied Eel.desc: Jellied eel! Eel in jelly made of eel! By the ten!
Jellied Eel.name: jellied eel

Squire's Delight.name: squire's delight
Squire's Delight.desc: A deep-fried butter stick. Beloved by squires, often stolen by knights.

Nitzel.desc: A deep-fried nitzel, coated in toastcrumbs and ready to eat.
Nitzel.name: nitzel

Schnitzel.desc: Tenderized spider meat, awaiting a coating of toastcrumbs and a hot oil bath.
Schnitzel.name: schnitzel

Aubergine(cheese).desc: Stuffed aubergine with cheese on top. Fit for a king!
Aubergine(cheese).name: stuffed aubergine with cheese

Pumpkin Slice.desc: A neatly sliced bit of pumpkin. Typically cooked first.
Pumpkin Slice.name: pumpkin slice

Pumpkin Loaf.desc: A loaf of sweetbread baked into a shape worthy of its name. Pumpkin loaves are surprising desserts, easily shared.
Pumpkin Loaf.name: pumpkin loaf

Pumpkin Balls.desc: Crispy and soft ball of dough mixed with pumpkin. A surprisingly nice snack.
Pumpkin Balls.name: pumpkin balls

Muffin.desc: Simple to prepare and enjoyed by everyone. Treat in a mushroom shaped package. Could do with something on top.
Muffin.name: muffin

Honey Muffin.desc: A mushroom shaped treat for whole topped off with honey. Still needs to be baked!
Honey Muffin.name: raw honey muffin

Cheese Muffin.desc: A mushroom shaped treat for whole topped off with cheese. Still needs to be baked!
Cheese Muffin.name: raw cheese muffin

Frybird Bucket.desc: Hearty, comforting, and rich - Ferentian Frybirds are the best on the entire continent and now even in a convinient bucket!
Frybird Bucket.name: frybird bucket

Bird filled Bird-roast.desc: A plump bird, roasted perfection.. filled with another bird - what compelled you to make this? Psydon Weeps at your hubris.
Bird filled Bird-roast.name: bird filled bird-roast

Ducal Bird-Roast.desc: A plump bird, roasted perfection, spiced to taste divine with touch of garlick to top it all off. Perfect to feast on while your son is dying in battle...
Ducal Bird-Roast.name: ducal bird-roast

Butter Bird-Roast.desc: A plump bird, roasted perfection, overflowing with butter from the inside.
Butter Bird-Roast.name: butter bird-roast

Coated Strudel.desc: The peak of Grenzelhoftian peasant food - an elongated pastry filled with apple paste and nuts is sure to keep the hunger cramps away. This one even has sugar coating!
Coated Strudel.name: coated strudel

Hunter's Feast.desc: A slab of volf, fried to a perfect medium rare. A bit gamey and chewy, but tasty. This piece has been coated over in glove of garlick and served with side of cucumber.
Hunter's Feast.name: hunter's feast

Elven Cabbit Roast.desc: A slab of cabbit, fried to a perfect crispy texture - coated over in glove of garlick and served with side of cucumber. Thought to bring good luck by rangers!
Elven Cabbit Roast.name: elven cabbit roast

Wiener Nitzel.desc: A deep-fried wiener, coated in toastcrumbs and ready to eat.
Wiener Nitzel.name: wiener nitzel

Tender Frybird.desc: A deep-fried frybird, coated in toastcrumbs and ready to eat.
Tender Frybird.name: tender frybird

Dried Fish Filet.desc: A slab of aquatic meat, salted harder than the living thing was. A staple of any traveler alongside coastal regions, make sure to pack enough water with it.
Dried Fish Filet.name: dried fish filet

Trail-Mix.desc: A collection of dried and long lasting snacks tucked into a neat package to be indulged in as needed. Favorite of rangers due to its simplicity and availability.
Trail-Mix.name: trail-mix

Tomatoplate (Cheese).desc: A culinary delight from Ferentia's shores, purported to've originated from an inflow of Etruscean refugees from long ago. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket; all it's missing is a cold pint of ale and an ongoing game of lampternball to jeer at.
Tomatoplate (Cheese).name: tomatoplate

Tomatoplate (Sausage).desc: A culinary delight from Ferentia's shores, purported to've originated from an inflow of Etruscean refugees from long ago. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket and crispy sasuages; all it's missing is a cold pint of ale and an ongoing game of lampternball to jeer at.
Tomatoplate (Sausage).name: sausaged tomatoplate

Tomatoplate (Truffles).desc: A culinary delight from Ferentia's shores, purported to've originated from an inflow of Etruscean refugees from long ago. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket and decadant truffles; all it's missing is a cold pint of ale and an ongoing game of lampternball to jeer at.
Tomatoplate (Truffles).name: truffled tomatoplate

Tomatoplate (Poison Truffles).desc: A culinary delight from Ferentia's shores, purported to've originated from an inflow of Etruscean refugees from long ago. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket and decadant truffles; all it's missing is a cold pint of ale and an ongoing game of lampternball to jeer at.
Tomatoplate (Poison Truffles).name: truffled tomatoplate

Tomatoplate (Fish).desc: A culinary delight from Ferentia's shores, purported to've originated from an inflow of Etruscean refugees from long ago. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket and oily fishes; all it's missing is a cold pint of ale and an ongoing game of lampternball to jeer at.
Tomatoplate (Fish).name: fished tomatoplate

Tomatoplate (Pear).desc: A curious spin on an Ferentian classic, attributed to the hands of Vanderlin's most esteemed culinarians. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket and sweet pears; a melody of flavors that has helped to embolden the creativity of Psydonia's artists for centuries-hence, and - hopefully - centuries-more.
Tomatoplate (Pear).name: pearacotta tomatoplate

Tomatoplate (Onion).desc: A culinary delight from Ferentia's shores, purported to've originated from an inflow of Etruscean refugees from long ago. The richness of the flatbread's sauced tomatoes is perfectly complemented by its cheesey blanket and crunchy onions; all it's missing is a cold pint of ale and an ongoing game of lampternball to jeer at.
Tomatoplate (Onion).name: onioned tomatoplate

pear-stuffed butterdough (BookBread).desc: Children on Nocsmas are traditionally granted both book and pastry without expectation of exchange, this variety is prefered by most little ones.
pear-stuffed butterdough (BookBread).name: pear bookbread

plum-stuffed butterdough (BookBread).desc: The origin of Nocsmas are shrouded in mystery, perhaps intentionally so, though some theorize it may have had its origins as an originally Psydonian holidae.
plum-stuffed butterdough (BookBread).name: plum bookbread

lemon-stuffed butterdough(BookBread).desc: Though many followers of Her find the holidae laughable, it's undeniably an important respite from the doom and gloom of the darkest month.
lemon-stuffed butterdough(BookBread).name: lemon bookbread

tangerine-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.desc: Even the coldest, darkest nites end eventually. Better to weather them with friends than to hide away.
tangerine-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.name: tangerine bookbread

blackberry-stuffed butterdough (BookBrea.desc: Following Her ascension, the great exchanging of books has met steady decline, as neighbor suspects neighbor more and more. Yet, even such prejudices could never hope to fully smother the spirit of Nocmas.
blackberry-stuffed butterdough (BookBrea.name: blackberry bookbread

raspberry-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.desc: Spending the long cold months in academic rather than intimate pursuit is preferable for most devout Noccians.
raspberry-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.name: raspberry bookbread

jackberry-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.desc: As Nocsmas gained broader appeal, more and more commonfolk with poor access to books instead chose to simply forego their exchanging, focusing instead on the preparation of food.
jackberry-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.name: jacksberried bookbread

jackberry-stuffed butterdough (Poisoned).desc: As Nocsmas gained broader appeal, more and more commonfolk with poor access to books instead chose to simply forego their exchanging, focusing instead on the preparation of food.
jackberry-stuffed butterdough (Poisoned).name: jacksberried bookbread

chocolate-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.desc: Nocsmas is not only a holiday for children and commoners, for Noccians are found most concentrated in the upper echelons of society. For these academics, it provies a much needed opportunity to share their secrets.
chocolate-stuffed butterdough (BookBread.name: chocolate bookbread

Tartar.desc: Grounded meat covered over with uncooked egg, favorite of the steppesmen. Said to have been named after a famous brigand.
Tartar.name: tartar

Baggy Desert Pants.name: baggy desert pants
Baggy Desert Pants.desc: A handmade pair of baggy, thin leather pants. Keeps sand out of your boots, sun off your legs, and a creacher's fangs from piercing your ankles.

Work trousers.name: work trousers
Work trousers.desc: Good quality trousers worn by laborers.

Apothecary Trousers.name: apothecary trousers
Apothecary Trousers.desc: Heavily padded trousers. They're stained by countless herbs.

Pontifex's Chaqchur.name: pontifex's chaqchur
Pontifex's Chaqchur.desc: A handmade pair of baggy, thin leather pants. They end in a tight stocking around the calf, ballooning out around the thigh.

Leather Trousers.name: leather trousers
Leather Trousers.desc: Good quality trousers worn by laborers.

Tinker Trousers.name: tinker trousers
Tinker Trousers.desc: Thick leather trousers designed to protect the wearer from sparks or stray gear projectiles. Judging by the scouring, its had plenty of use.

Leather Tights.name: leather tights
Leather Tights.desc: Classy leather tights, form-fitting but tasteful.

Hardened Leather Trousers.name: hardened leather trousers
Hardened Leather Trousers.desc: Thick hide cut and sewn into a pair of very protective trousers. The dense leather can turn away errant chops.

Fencing Breeches.name: fencing breeches
Fencing Breeches.desc: A pair of loose breeches with leather reinforcements on the waist and legs. Worn with a cup.

Heart Protector.name: heart protector
Heart Protector.desc: Very simple and crude protection for the chest. Ancient fighters once used similar gear, with better quality...

Padded Fencing Shirt.name: padded fencing shirt
Padded Fencing Shirt.desc: A strong loosely worn quilted shirt that places little weight on the arms, usually worn underneath a flexible leather vest. It won't cover your legs.

Arming Jacket.name: arming jacket
Arming Jacket.desc: A large shirt meant to be worn below armor.

Hardened Leather Jacket.name: hardened leather jacket
Hardened Leather Jacket.desc: A heavy leather jacket that covers the arms and protects the vitals.

Padded Gambeson.name: padded gambeson
Padded Gambeson.desc: A gambeson with additional padding layers, hardened to make it more durable. It still does not compare to leather or metal, but it will probably stop a crossbow bolt, so it's typically worn to complement proper armor.

Fencing Gambeson.name: fencing gambeson
Fencing Gambeson.desc: A large shirt with heavy padding meant to be used below armor. Will probably stop an arrow, unlikely to stop a bolt.

Hierophant's Shawl.name: hierophant's shawl
Hierophant's Shawl.desc: A thick robe intervowen with spell-laced fabrics. Thick and protective while remaining light and breezy; the perfect gear for protecting one from the threats of the sun, the desert and the daemons, yet still allowing one to cast spells aptly.

Padded Dress.name: padded dress
Padded Dress.desc: This dress has been padded with leather for extra protection. Bolts and arrows punch right through it.

Gambeson.name: gambeson
Gambeson.desc: A large shirt meant to be worn below armor.

Artificer Jacket.name: artificer jacket
Artificer Jacket.desc: A thick leather jacket adorned with fur and cog decals. The height of Heartfelt fashion.

Winter Jacket.name: winter jacket
Winter Jacket.desc: The most elegant of furs and vivid of royal dyes combined together into a most classy jacket.

Hardened Leather Armor.name: hardened leather armor
Hardened Leather Armor.desc: A heavy steerhide jerkin with enough body to stand on its own. It forms a stiff, protective mantle for its wearer, shielding from blows and weather alike.

Studded Leather Armor.name: studded leather armor
Studded Leather Armor.desc: Studded leather is the most durable of all hides and leathers and about as light.

Hide Armor.name: hide armor
Hide Armor.desc: A light armor of wildbeast hide. Far more durable than leather.

Silk Coat.name: silk coat
Silk Coat.desc: A padded dressing made from the finest silks.

Hardened Leather Coat.name: hardened leather coat
Hardened Leather Coat.desc: A heavy steerhide jerkin that reaches past the hips and better protects the vitals.

Fencer's Cuirass.name: fencer's cuirass
Fencer's Cuirass.desc: An expertly smithed form-fitting steel cuirass that is much lighter and agile. Backed with supple leather and silk, it's not only protective but luxurious to wear.

Hardened Leather Shorts.name: hardened leather shorts
Hardened Leather Shorts.desc: A thick hide pair of shorts, favored by some for their ease of motion in spite of being less protective than full trousers.

Light Gambeson.name: light gambeson
Light Gambeson.desc: A thin barely-padded gambeson, typically worn by the peasantry as cheap yet fashionable armor for the whole body. May stop an arrow.

Fencing Jacket.name: fencing jacket
Fencing Jacket.desc: A light, flexible button-up leather jacket that will keep your vitals out of harm's way.

Leather Armor.name: leather armor
Leather Armor.desc: Flexible cowhide armor. Lightweight, better than nothing.

Leather Vest.name: leather vest
Leather Vest.desc: A leather vest. Not very protective, but fashionable.

Brigantine Chausses.name: brigandine chausses
Brigantine Chausses.desc: Splint mail and brigandine chausses, designed to protect the legs while still providing almost complete free range of movement.

Decrepit Chain Kilt.name: decrepit chain kilt
Decrepit Chain Kilt.desc: Frayed bronze rings, linked together with bindings of rotting leather to form a waist's drape. The maille jingles with every step, singing the hymn to a cadence once savored by marching legionnaires.

(Iron) Chain Chausses.name: iron chain chausses
(Iron) Chain Chausses.desc: Chain leggings composed of interlinked metal rings.

(Steel) Hauberk.name: hauberk
(Steel) Hauberk.desc: A longer steel maille that protects the legs, still doesn't protect against arrows though.

Decrepit Hauberk.name: decrepit hauberk
Decrepit Hauberk.desc: Frayed bronze rings and rotting leather, woven together to form a sleeved maille-atekon. Once, the armored vestments of a paladin: now, the withered veil of Zizo's undying legionnaires.

Lightweight Brigantine.name: lightweight brigandine
Lightweight Brigantine.desc: A light riveted coat with plates concealed inside an exterior fabric. Susceptible to daggers being shoved into your ribs.

(Iron) Chainmaille.name: iron haubergeon
(Iron) Chainmaille.desc: A chain vest made of heavy iron rings. Better than nothing.

Decrepit Cuirass.name: decrepit cuirass
Decrepit Cuirass.desc: Frayed bronze, pounded into a breastplate. It feels more like a corset than a cuirass; there's barely enough width to let those aching lungs breathe.

(Iron) Breastplate.name: iron breastplate
(Iron) Breastplate.desc: A basic cuirass of iron, protective and moderately durable.

(Steel) Cuirass.name: steel cuirass
(Steel) Cuirass.desc: A basic cuirass of steel. Lightweight and durable. A crossbow bolt will probably go right through this, but not an arrow.

Steel Chain Kilt.name: steel chain kilt
Steel Chain Kilt.desc: Interlinked metal rings that drape down all the way to the ankles.

(Steel) Chain Chausses.name: steel chain chausses
(Steel) Chain Chausses.desc: Chain leggings composed of interlinked metal rings.

Steel Plate Tassets.name: steel plate tassets
Steel Plate Tassets.desc: A set of hanging plates of steel to protect the hips and thighs without too much burden.

(Steel) Haubergeon.name: haubergeon
(Steel) Haubergeon.desc: A steel maille shirt. Arrows and small daggers go right through the gaps in this.

Blacksteel Cuirass.name: blacksteel cuirass
Blacksteel Cuirass.desc: A basic cuirass forged from blacksteel. It's somewhat more durable than regular steel.

Fluted Cuirass.name: fluted cuirass
Fluted Cuirass.desc: An ornate steel cuirass, fitted with tassets for additional coverage. The intricate fluting not only attracts the maidens, but also strengthens the steel's resistance against repeated impacts.

Scalemail.name: scalemail
Scalemail.desc: Metal scales interwoven intricately to form flexible protection!

Decrepit Plate Chausses.name: decrepit plate chausses
Decrepit Plate Chausses.desc: Frayed bronze plates, shingled over chausses of rotting leather-and-maille. Voided bowels are all that remains of its former legionnaire.

Steel Plate Chausses.name: steel plate chausses
Steel Plate Chausses.desc: Reinforced armor to protect the legs.

Brigandine.name: brigandine
Brigandine.desc: Composite armour made according to an Etruscan tradition. It's a high-quality arched plate cuirass sewn with dyed leather and fitted with a wide skirt at the bottom to cover the groin.

Coat of Plates.name: coat of plates
Coat of Plates.desc: A leather coat with plates attached to increase protection while retaining mobility. The leather below might stop a dagger.

Plate Armor.name: plate armor
Plate Armor.desc: Full steel plate armor. Slow to don and doff without the aid of a good squire.

Decrepit Half-Plate.name: decrepit half-plate
Decrepit Half-Plate.desc: Frayed bronze layers, bolted into plate armor. Once, the hauberk of a rising champion; now, nothing more than a fool's tomb.

Steel Half-Plate.name: steel half-plate
Steel Half-Plate.desc: \'Adventurer-fit\' plate armor with pauldrons. The poor fitting leaves many small gaps for daggers and bolts to pierce something vital, so a gambeson is recommended.

Bracers.name: leather bracers
Bracers.desc: Standard leather bracers that offer some meager protection for the arms.

Brigantine Rerebraces.name: brigandine rerebraces
Brigantine Rerebraces.desc: Brigandine bracers, pauldrons and a set of metal couters, designed to protect the arms while still providing almost complete free range of movement.

Copper Bracers.name: copper bracers
Copper Bracers.desc: Copper forearm guards that offer some protection while looking rather stylish

Decrepit Bracers.name: decrepit bracers
Decrepit Bracers.desc: Frayed bronze cuffings, bound across the wrists. Don't bother counting the tallies left behind by their former legionnaires; none of them ever returned from the battlefields.

Steel Bracers.name: bracers
Steel Bracers.desc: Steel bracers that protect the arms.

Iron Bracers.name: iron bracers
Iron Bracers.desc: Iron bracers that protect the arms.

Forge Gauntlets.name: forge gauntlets
Forge Gauntlets.desc: Regal gloves of Grenzelhoftian design, more a fashion statement than actual protection.

Heavy Leather Gloves.name: heavy leather gloves
Heavy Leather Gloves.desc: A heavier pair of leather gloves with extra padding. These look like they can take some beating. Fair melee protection and decent durability.

Decrepit Chain Gauntlets.name: decrepit chain gauntlets
Decrepit Chain Gauntlets.desc: Frayed bronze rings, interlinked together to form sagging mittens. Fingers, talons, claws; they're all the same, when smothered beneath maille and left to rot away.

Chain Gauntlets.name: chain gauntlets
Chain Gauntlets.desc: Gauntlets made of interlinked steel rings. They offer decent protection against common weaponries, except for arrows.

Decrepit Plate Gauntlets.name: decrepit plate gauntlets
Decrepit Plate Gauntlets.desc: Frayed bronze mechanisms, connected to form the shells of hands. Too clumsy to properly knock a bow, too rigid to comfortably grip a sword; clench those fists any tighter, and the segments'll cut into flesh.

Plate Gauntlets.name: plate gauntlets
Plate Gauntlets.desc: Plate gauntlets made out of steel. Good all-around protection for the hands.

Winged Cap.name: winged cap
Winged Cap.desc: A helmet with two wings on its sides.

Moose Hood.name: moose hood
Moose Hood.desc: A deceptively strong hood of hide with a pair of large heavy antlers. It is the reward of the fourth trial of the Zayran Shamans, To slay a Grinning moose in the final hunt alone and fashion a hood from it's head.

Grenzelhoft Plume Hat.name: grenzelhoft plume hat
Grenzelhoft Plume Hat.desc: Whether it's monsters or fair maidens, a true Grenzelhoftian slays both. This hat contains a hidden metallic cap underneath to protect the head from blows.

Hardened Leather Helmet.name: hardened leather helmet
Hardened Leather Helmet.desc: Sturdy, durable, flexible. A comfortable and reliable hood made of hardened leather.

Saiga Skull.name: saiga skull
Saiga Skull.desc: The skull of a fearsome saiga. Looks like it could withstand some damage.

Barbute.name: barbute
Barbute.desc: A simple helmet with a visor in the shape of a Y.

Decrepit Barbute.name: decrepit barbute
Decrepit Barbute.desc: Frayed bronze plates, pounded into a visored helmet. Scrapes and dents line the curved plating, weathered from centuries of neglect. The remains of a plume's stub hang atop its rim.

Decrepit Savoyard.name: decrepit savoyard
Decrepit Savoyard.desc: Frayed bronze plates, molded into a ventilated casket. It reeks of fetid shit, and each breath - labored and strained - is laced with flaked metal.

Bucket Helmet.name: bucket helmet
Bucket Helmet.desc: A helmet which covers the whole of the head. Offers excellent protection.

Armet.name: armet
Armet.desc: Holy lamb, sacrificial hero, blessed idiot - Psydon endures. Will you endure alongside Him, as a knight of humenity, or crumble before temptation?

Abyssorite Helmet.name: abyssorite helmet
Abyssorite Helmet.desc: A helmet commonly worn by Templars in service to Abyssor. It evokes imagery of the sea with a menacing crustacean visage.

Knight's Helmet.name: knight's helmet
Knight's Helmet.desc: A noble knight's helm in the current style popular with nobility. Add a feather to show the colors of your family or allegiance.

Barred Helmet.name: barred helmet
Barred Helmet.desc: A helmet which offers good protection to the face at the expense of vision.

Volf-Face Helm.name: volf-face helm
Volf-Face Helm.desc: A steel bascinet helmet with a volfish visor protecting the head, ears, eyes, nose and mouth.

Lamellar Cap.name: lamellar cap
Lamellar Cap.desc: A heavy lamellar cap made out of copper. Despite the primitive material, it's an effective design that keeps the head safe.

Sallet.name: sallet
Sallet.desc: A steel helmet which protects the ears.

(Steel) Helmet.name: helmet
(Steel) Helmet.desc: A helmet that doesn't get any more simple in design.

Kettle Helmet.name: kettle helmet
Kettle Helmet.desc: A steel helmet which protects the top and sides of the head.

Bascinet.name: bascinet
Bascinet.desc: A steel bascinet helmet. Though it lacks a visor, it still protects the head and ears.

Pigface Bascinet.name: pigface bascinet
Pigface Bascinet.desc: A steel bascinet helmet with a pigface visor that protects the entire head and face. Add a feather to show the colors of your family or allegiance.

Visored Sallet.name: visored sallet
Visored Sallet.desc: A steel helmet which protects the ears, nose, and eyes.

Padded Coif.name: padded coif
Padded Coif.desc: A cheap and simple gambeson coif meant to be worn on its own or under a helmet. It's better than nothing.

Volf Helm.name: volf helmet
Volf Helm.desc: A leather helmet fashioned from a volf's head.

Padded Headscarf.name: padded headscarf
Padded Headscarf.desc: A common sight amongst those travelling the long desert routes, it offers protection from the heat and a modicum of it against the beasts that prowl its more comfortable nites.

Studded Leather Hood.name: studded leather hood
Studded Leather Hood.desc: A thick studded leather hood with buckles.

Decrepit Coif.name: decrepit coif
Decrepit Coif.desc: Frayed bronze rings, linked together to form a billowing hood. Shrapnel peppers the linkage; arrowheads and speartips, brought along from a battlefield who's history - and legionnaires - have been lost to tyme.

Steel Chain Coif.name: chain coif
Steel Chain Coif.desc: Offers superior coverage to a simple gorget, though it sacrifices some protection in return.

Padded Leather Hood.name: padded leather hood
Padded Leather Hood.desc: A padded leather hood with buckles.

Hardened Leather Gorget.name: hardened leather gorget
Hardened Leather Gorget.desc: Sturdy. Durable. Will protect your neck from some good lumbering.

Decrepit Gorget.name: decrepit gorget
Decrepit Gorget.desc: Frayed bronze plates, shingled together to shroud the neck. Primitive scrapes line the flanks, yet the center seems to've been cored out by a spear's thrust.

Steel Gorget.name: steel gorget
Steel Gorget.desc: A series of iron plates designed to protect the neck.

Neck Protector.name: neck protector
Neck Protector.desc: An antique and simple protection for the neck, used more as an accessory by the common folk. But poor protection is still better than nothing.

Bevor.name: bevor
Bevor.desc: A series of steel plates designed to protect the neck.

Otavan Leather Boots.name: otavan leather boots
Otavan Leather Boots.desc: Boots of outstanding craft, your fragile feet have never felt so protected and comfortable before.

Heavy Leather Boots.name: heavy leather boots
Heavy Leather Boots.desc: Sturdy boots stitched together from cured leather. Stylish, firm, and sport a satisfying 'squeek' with each step.

Plated Boots.name: plated boots
Plated Boots.desc: Boots forged of a set of steel plates to protect your fragile toes.

Cauldron.name: cauldron
Cauldron.desc: Bubble, Bubble, toil and trouble. A great iron cauldron for brewing potions.

Wheat Grain.name: wheat grain
Wheat Grain.desc: Wheat grains, ready to be milled into powder.

Swampweed.name: swampweed
Swampweed.desc: A pipeweed with pungent odor and a sparkling surface.

Fat.name: fat
Fat.desc: A lump of animal fat, fit for oiling and sausage-stuffing.

Rice.name: rice grain
Rice.desc: Rice grains, ready to be worked with water to be cleaned.

Sugarcane.name: sugarcane
Sugarcane.desc: A tall, leafy plant with a thick, fibrous stalk. It can be milled into sugar. Commonly eaten as a snack in part of kazengun.

Coffee Cherry.name: coffee cherry
Coffee Cherry.desc: A small sweet, small red fruit that contains coffee bean(s) inside. Can be grounded in a millstone for coffee beans.

Frypan.name: frypan
Frypan.desc: Two in one: Cook and smash heads.

Volf Meat.desc: Meat taken from a volf. Stringy, tough, and gamey - but edible.
Volf Meat.name: raw volf meat

Cabbage.name: cabbage
Cabbage.desc: A dense leafed vegetable, crunchy and ripe. A symbol of prosperity for elves.

Onion.name: onion
Onion.desc: A wonderful vegetable with many layers and broad flavor profile.

Potato.name: potato
Potato.desc: A spud, dwarven icon of growth. Can be eaten raw.

Cucumber.name: cucumber
Cucumber.desc: A long, green vegetable that is crunchy and refreshing. Can be sliced for easier consumption.

Garlick Bulb.name: garlick bulb
Garlick Bulb.desc: Hated by the foule vampyres that lurk in the dark - garlick!

Turnip.name: turnip
Turnip.desc: A shield against hunger, naught else.

Crab.name: crab
Crab.desc: A defensive shellfish that's a real hassle to crack open, they taste great when made into cakes with butterdough slice.

Apple.name: apple
Apple.desc: Deliciously crisp and fragrant. It's said that archers will sometimes place these crimson fruits atop another's head, in order to flaunt their accuracy with a longbow. A successful hit, and the crowd claps without harm; a mote's deviation, however, and someone's going to end up being hauled into the Church.

Cheese Wedge.desc: Talk about a chunk of cheddar!
Cheese Wedge.name: wedge of cheese

Cooked Pumpkin Mash.desc: Once bland, now a surprisingly rich and fibrous mash.
Cooked Pumpkin Mash.name: cooked pumpkin mash

Tangerine.name: tangerine
Tangerine.desc: A small, easy-to-peel citrus fruit with a vibrant orange color and sweet, juicy segments. It is most popularly known for being the predecessor to 'marmalade'; a deliciously spreadable jam, born through smothering tangerines in sugar and dousing them in boiling fat.

Plum.name: plum
Plum.desc: A smooth-skinned fruit with juicy, sweet-tart flesh and a deep purple or red hue.

Blackberry.name: blackberry
Blackberry.desc: A small, dark fruit with a sweet and slightly tart taste. It is often used in desserts, or - when smothered in sugar and doused in boiling fat - jams.

Raspberry.name: raspberry
Raspberry.desc: A small, red fruit with a sweet and slightly tart taste. It is often used in desserts.

Strawberry.name: strawberry
Strawberry.desc: A small, red fruit with a sweet taste. It is often used in desserts.

Pear.name: pear
Pear.desc: A juicy, bell-shaped fruit with a delicate sweetness and soft, grainy flesh.

Carrot.name: carrot
Carrot.desc: A long vegetable said to help with eyesight. Often baked

Lemon.name: lemon
Lemon.desc: A bright yellow citrus fruit, prized for its tart, refreshing juice and fragrant zest.

Lime.name: lime
Lime.desc: A small, green citrus fruit with a sharp, tangy flavor, often used to add zest to dishes and drinks.

Rocknut.name: rocknut
Rocknut.desc: A fragrant nut with stimulating properties, oft-delighted with herbal sugar. Its powder is valuable for fashioning zigs and allspices.

Cooked Rice.desc: Plain cooked rice, a staple food in many cultures.
Cooked Rice.name: cooked rice

Frysteak.desc: A slab of beastflesh, fried to a perfect medium-rare
Frysteak.name: frysteak

Roast Pork.desc: A hunk of pigflesh, roasted to a perfect crispy texture
Roast Pork.name: roast pork

Cooked Shrimp.desc: A cooked shrimp. Firm and springy with a natural hint of saltiness.
Cooked Shrimp.name: cooked shrimp

Frybird.desc: Poultry scorched to a perfect delicious crisp.
Frybird.name: frybird

Fried Onion.desc: Seared onions roasted to a delicious set of rings.
Fried Onion.name: fried onion

Cooked Salmon.desc: A cooked salmon. Less terrifying now that it is cooked. It has rich and oily flesh, making it quite popular once spiced.
Cooked Salmon.name: cooked salmon

Cooked Lobster.desc: A cooked lobster. It has a rich and sweet flavor, but not much meat. On its own it is consideredfood for the poor, but buttered or peppered it is a delicacy.
Cooked Lobster.name: cooked lobster

Cooked Sole.desc: A cooked sole, with a mild flavor and flaky texture. Fit for the poor.
Cooked Sole.name: cooked sole

Cooked Plaice.desc: A cooked plaice. With a mild and sweet flavor. Popular with the rich.
Cooked Plaice.name: cooked plaice

Cooked Cod.desc: A cooked cod, with a mild flavor and flaky texture. Quite popular.
Cooked Cod.name: cooked cod

Cooked Clam.desc: A cooked clam. With a sweet and briny flavor, clams are often used in soup.
Cooked Clam.name: cooked clam

Cooked Seabass.desc: A cooked seabass. With a firm texture, seabass goes well with spices and sauces.
Cooked Seabass.name: cooked seabass

Eel.name: eel
Eel.desc: A sinuous eel that slithers through the dark waters.

Pot.name: pot
Pot.desc: A pot made out of iron. It can hold a lot of liquid.

Eggplant.name: eggplant
Eggplant.desc: A large, purple vegetable with a mild taste. Can be carved to be filled up.

pumpkin.desc: The thick pumpkin rind shields a surprisingly dense fleshy interior.
pumpkin.name: pumpkin

Roast Bird.desc: A plump bird, roasted to a perfect temperature and bears a crispy skin.
Roast Bird.name: roast bird

Fried Volf.desc: A slab of volf, fried to a perfect medium rare. A bit gamey and chewy, but tasty.
Fried Volf.name: fried volf

Fried Cabbit.desc: A slab of cabbit, fried to a perfect crispy texture.
Fried Cabbit.name: fried cabbit

Fish Filet.desc: A filet of fish. All of them are the same inside.
Fish Filet.name: fish filet

Roasted Seeds.name: roasted seeds
Roasted Seeds.desc: Food for birds, treats for humens.

Ration Wrapping Paper.name: ration wrapping paper
Ration Wrapping Paper.desc: A piece of paper greased with a thin layer of oil, used to wrap food and preserve it for a long journey. The final size of the ration depends on the size of the original food item. The food will last as long as the ration is wrapped.

Tomato.name: tomato
Tomato.desc: A plump, red fruit with juicy flesh and a balanced sweet-tart flavor, essential in salads and sauces. A seasoned culinarian knowns to always split their tomatoes, in order to fashion the smoothest sauces.

Halved Chocolate Ingot.name: halved chocolate ingot
Halved Chocolate Ingot.desc: An unbelievably decadant halve of fudge, made with Amazonia's cocoa beans and Grenzelhoft's saiga milk. A recent trade agreement between the two nations has turned this once-expensive delicacy into a slightly-less-expensive treat for many. </br>Following a rather unfortunate diplomatic incident involving a Lupian nobleman and a box of chocolates, chocolate is also now-known to double as a potent 'humor rebalancer' for some of Dendor's children. </br>When combined with pumpkin spice and tossed into a kettle, it makes for an absolutely divine drink.

Minced Cabbit.desc: Meat sliced many times both with and against the grain, producing a fine mince.
Minced Cabbit.name: minced cabbit

Minced Poultry.desc: Meat sliced many times both with and against the grain, producing a fine mince.
Minced Poultry.name: minced poultry

Minced Meat.desc: Meat sliced many times both with and against the grain, producing a fine mince.
Minced Meat.name: minced meat

Butter Slice.name: butter
Butter Slice.desc: A portion of milky paradise. Kneading it into dough is necessary to prepare many of Psydonia's pastries, though the more humble-hearted prefer to simply doll up a slice of toast with it.

slab of half-done cookiedough.desc: Doughy, soft, and speckled with chocolate. A little less than 'unacceptable', but still far too raw to peck at.. maybe some more chocolate, to round it out?
slab of half-done cookiedough.name: slab of half-done cookiedough

slab of half-done raelseinidough.desc: Doughy, soft, and speckled with raisins. A little less than 'unacceptable', but still far too raw to peck at.. maybe some more raisins, to round it out?
slab of half-done raelseinidough.name: slab of half-done raelseinidough

slab of half-done carameliedough.desc: Doughy, soft, and speckled with caramel dropplings. A little less than 'unacceptable', but still far too raw to peck at.. maybe some more caramel, to round it out?
slab of half-done carameliedough.name: slab of half-done carameliedough

slab of half-done drag\u00e9elidough.desc: Doughy, soft, and speckled with dragée dropplings. A little less than 'unacceptable', but still far too raw to peck at.. maybe some more dragée, to round it out?
slab of half-done drag\u00e9elidough.name: slab of half-done dragéelidough

jamtallowed toast.desc: A blackberried jam, smeared across a slice of toast. It is favored as a delicacy by Psydonia's peasantry and yeomen, and is usually reserved to crown the start of a particularly special dae.
jamtallowed toast.name: jamtallowed toast

marmaladed toast.desc: A tangerine marmalade served on a bed of warm crustless bread topped with another piece of warm crustless bread. One bite, and it can satiate even a starving bear's stomach!
marmaladed toast.name: marmaladed toast

ham bread.desc: A piece of toast with a thick slice of ham on top. A delight enjoyed by many burghers.
ham bread.name: ham bread

jamtallowed bun.desc: A delicious treat to bring along for those long-and-lonesome hikes through the Naledian deserts; doubly-so, if you happen to be smuggling enough starsugar to buy out Astrata's throne.
jamtallowed bun.name: jamtallowed bun

marmaladed bun.desc: A delicious treat to bring along for those long-and-lonesome hikes through the Ferentian forests; doubly-so, if you happen to be a tallow-coated wildkin of the urisine variety.
marmaladed bun.name: marmaladed bun

marmaladed crossbun.desc: A particularly favorite treat amonst the papacies of Grenzelhoft and Etruscea, especially during the holidaes that pay reverance to Astrata. The marmalade is said to represent the Sun's blessed light and warming radiance, though the spiritual implication tends to be lost on more eager-minded children.
marmaladed crossbun.name: marmaladed crossbun

jamtallowed psycrossbun.desc: A particularly favorite treat amonst the papacies of Otava and Rockhill, especially during the holidaes that pay reverance to Psydon's sacrifice. The jamtallow is said to represent the Weeping God's tears, though the spiritual implication tends to be lost on more eager-minded children.
jamtallowed psycrossbun.name: jamtallowed psycrossbun

marmaladed psycrossbun.desc: Wait, isn't it meant to be the other way around? Ah, well!
marmaladed psycrossbun.name: marmaladed psycrossbun

frosted cake base.desc: With this sweet frosted thing, you shall make them sing and dance.
frosted cake base.name: frosted cake base

wiener egg.desc: Fried egg with sausage on the side. A good start to a perfect morning.
wiener egg.name: wiener egg

wiener egg with bacon.desc: Fried egg with sausage and bacon on the side. Mere step away from greatness.
wiener egg with bacon.name: wiener egg with bacon

forest trove.desc: A choice cut of venison seared to perfection with a hint of pink flesh still visible.
forest trove.name: forest trove

mellow forest trove.desc: A choice cut of venison seared to perfection with a hint of pink flesh still visible. Drowned in a good slice of butter, as if it weren't soft enough before.
mellow forest trove.name: mellow forest trove

forest glaze.desc: A helping of venison ribs glazed to perfection in honey. The golden brown flesh is almost shiny enough for you to see your own reflection.
forest glaze.name: forest glaze

couronne de baies-noires.desc: A crown fashioned from wyrd meat rib-bones, cooked to the point most of the juicy meat has sagged to the bottom. The meat-mash is dotted with countless jackberries down below.
couronne de baies-noires.name: couronne de baies-noires

bouquet des tr\u00e9pass\u00e9s.desc: A strange dish of prime wyrd meat, sliced thin and assembled to look like roses. These are typically left on graves to commemorate someone. Otavan vampires make a habit out of trying to steal these off graves, for they desire the strange flesh.
bouquet des tr\u00e9pass\u00e9s.name: bouquet des trépassés

grave galette.desc: A patchwork amalgamation of various meats, but primarily that of wyrd meat. It is a meatloaf, but you'd rather it didn't exist at all.
grave galette.name: grave galette

onion steak.desc: Roasted meat garnished with fragrant fried onions, then slathered with the juices of both for a perfect mouth-watering sauce.
onion steak.name: onion steak

carrot steak.desc: Roasted meat paired with a savory baked carrot, then slathered with the juices of both for a perfect mouth-watering sauce.
carrot steak.name: carrot steak

garlick cabbit.desc: A slab of cabbit, fried to a perfect crispy texture - coated over in glove of garlick.
garlick cabbit.name: garlick cabbit

garlick volf.desc: A slab of volf, fried to a perfect medium rare. A bit gamey and chewy, but tasty. This piece has been coated over in glove of garlick.
garlick volf.name: garlick volf

pepperfilet.desc: Roasted fish flipped against itself and coated in pepper.
pepperfilet.name: pepperfilet

slab of cookiedough.desc: Doughy, soft, and drenched in chocolate. Now that is acceptable, through-and-through! Time for a stint in the oven, first!
slab of cookiedough.name: slab of cookiedough

slab of drag\u00e9elidough.desc: Doughy, soft, and drenched in dragée. Now that is acceptable, through-and-through! Time for a stint in the oven, first!
slab of drag\u00e9elidough.name: slab of dragéelidough

slab of carameliedough.desc: Doughy, soft, and drenched in caramel. Now that is acceptable, through-and-through! Time for a stint in the oven, first!
slab of carameliedough.name: slab of carameliedough

slab of raelseinidough.desc: Doughy, soft, and drenched in raisins. Now that is acceptable, through-and-through! Time for a stint in the oven, first!
slab of raelseinidough.name: slab of raelseinidough

slice of jamtallowed bookbread.desc: 'Don't think that I'd forget, or I'd regret, the special love I had for you - my baby blue!'
slice of jamtallowed bookbread.name: slice of jamtallowed bookbread

slice of marmaladed bookbread.desc: 'I always keep a marmalade sandwich under my sallet, just in case!'
slice of marmaladed bookbread.name: slice of marmaladed bookbread

rice and cheese.desc: Rice with a layer of melted cheese.
rice and cheese.name: rice and cheese

unfinished stuffed aubergine.desc: An eggplant stuffed with raw meat, ready to be topped with tomato.
unfinished stuffed aubergine.name: unfinished stuffed aubergine

raw stuffed aubergine.desc: A stuffed aubergine with raw meat and tomato, ready to be cooked.
raw stuffed aubergine.name: raw stuffed aubergine

crackerdough.desc: Doughy, soft, unacceptable - such makes it perfect for hardtack. Sprinkling in some sliced chocolate might help make it a little more palletable.
crackerdough.name: crackerdough

caramel giblets.name: caramel giblets
caramel giblets.desc: Glassy droppings of tallow-fried sugar, oft-divvied out amongst the youth by Psydonia's wisest and kindliest elders.

drag\u00e9e.name: dragée
drag\u00e9e.desc: Glassy droppings of tallow-fried rocknuts, coated in sugary shells and laced with herbal medicine. Such giblets are popular amongst Psydonia's youth - both as a reward to Otavan children for remembering their scripture, and as a remedy to childhood ailments.

sliced bread.desc: A bit of comfort to start your dae. The finest choice-of-vessel for a slice of saloumi, salo, cheese, bacon, or jam.
sliced bread.name: sliced bread

slice of jamtallow.name: slice of jamtallow
slice of jamtallow.desc: A portion of jammy paradise, bearing the same hues as Ferentia's morning skies. It yearns to be savored not by its lonesome, but upon a slice of bread - ideally, butterdoughed or toasted.

slice of marmalade.name: slice of marmalade
slice of marmalade.desc: A portion of jammy paradise, bearing the same hues as Ferentia's evening seas. It yearns to be savored not by its lonesome, but upon a slice of bread - ideally, butterdoughed or toasted.

sliced ham.desc: Perfect cut of swine flesh, raw and ready to be steamed.
sliced ham.name: sliced ham

cake.desc: Soft and tender, a base or a delicious treat for the impatient.
cake.name: cake

baked carrot.desc: A carrot baked to a golden brown, with a soft and sweet interior.
baked carrot.name: baked carrot

venison prime cut.desc: A prime cut of venison prepared by a skilled butcher. Not only tender, but incredibly filling too. A meal fit for a duke, often regarded by others with jealousy.
venison prime cut.name: venison prime cut

venison ribs.desc: The ribs of some cervine. It is a meaty, filling cut often cherised by commonfolk as a true feast, albeit the vert of the woods isn't meant to be touched by peasants.
venison ribs.name: venison ribs

deadite venison ribs.desc: The heavier chunk of undead flesh. Filling, but hard to stomach, a feast for the desperate nonetheless.
deadite venison ribs.name: deadite venison ribs

deadite venison prime cut.desc: Not even death could stop the creature from yielding its most prime cut. Lyckers might even consider flesh over blood at the sight.
deadite venison prime cut.name: deadite venison prime cut

deadite venison.desc: The undead still carry flesh, tough, chewy. It is an aquired taste.
deadite venison.name: deadite venison

baked potatoes.desc: A dwarven favorite, as a meal or a game of hot potato.
baked potatoes.name: baked potatoes

fryfilet.desc: A slab of flaky fish, fried until falling apart.
fryfilet.name: fryfilet

strudel.desc: The peak of Grenzelhoftian peasant food - an elongated pastry filled with apple paste and nuts is sure to keep the hunger cramps away.
strudel.name: strudel

sliced bookbread.desc: About the same size and taste as an encyclopedia.
sliced bookbread.name: sliced bookbread

carved aubergine.desc: An eggplant with its insides hollowed out, ready to be stuffed with meat.
carved aubergine.name: carved aubergine

stuffed aubergine.desc: Eggplant stuffed with meat and tomato. Delicious!
stuffed aubergine.name: stuffed aubergine

bookbread loaf.desc: On the days when Noc's reign lengthens to its apex, all proper Pantheon-fearing folk huddle by their warm hearths, exchanging both books and pastries such as this.
bookbread loaf.name: bookbread loaf

apple loaf slice.desc: Soft and chewy. Nourishing and filling. Simple yet decadant. Certainly a step up from raisins, that's for sure.
apple loaf slice.name: apple loaf slice

raisin loaf slice.desc: Soft and chewy. Nourishing and filling. Simple and decent.
raisin loaf slice.name: raisin loaf slice

pumpkin loaf slice.desc: Soft and chewy. It's surprisingly light despite its origin.
pumpkin loaf slice.name: pumpkin loaf slice

uncooked pumpkin ball.desc: A simple ball of dough, yearning to be cookied or fried.
uncooked pumpkin ball.name: uncooked pumpkin ball

apple loaf.desc: A fresher cousin of the oft-adored 'raisin loaf', bespeckled with baked apples that dare to melt upon an indulger's tongue. It holds a special place in the hearts of Valoria's people, for both the peasantry and nobility.
apple loaf.name: apple loaf

pear-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of pear-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
pear-stuffed butterdough.name: pear-stuffed butterdough

plum-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of plum-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
plum-stuffed butterdough.name: plum-stuffed butterdough

lemon-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of lemon-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
lemon-stuffed butterdough.name: lemon-stuffed butterdough

tangerine-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of tangerine-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
tangerine-stuffed butterdough.name: tangerine-stuffed butterdough

blackberry-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of blackberry-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
blackberry-stuffed butterdough.name: blackberry-stuffed butterdough

raspberry-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of raspberry-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
raspberry-stuffed butterdough.name: raspberry-stuffed butterdough

jackberry-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of jacksberry-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
jackberry-stuffed butterdough.name: jackberry-stuffed butterdough

sliced pear bookbread.desc: Evokes the sweetness of younger, simpler times, and simpler books.
sliced pear bookbread.name: sliced pear bookbread

sliced plum bookbread.desc: A subtle flavor, best for enjoying subtler books. Mysteries prefered.
sliced plum bookbread.name: sliced plum bookbread

sliced lemon bookbread.desc: Sweet but a little sour, like a good Xylixian comedy.
sliced lemon bookbread.name: sliced lemon bookbread

sliced tangerine bookbread.desc: Fills one with heroic vigor and hopeful enthusiasm, similar to historic-fantasies of old.
sliced tangerine bookbread.name: sliced tangerine bookbread

sliced blackberry bookbread.desc: It evokes a feeling of contrasting fascination and dread, not unlike novels that may foretell a doom similar to what befell this very berry.
sliced blackberry bookbread.name: sliced blackberry bookbread

sliced raspberry bookbread.desc: Has a taste that puts one in the mood for a good romance novel. For obvious reasons, this flavor isnt very popular with mages.
sliced raspberry bookbread.name: sliced raspberry bookbread

sliced jacksberried bookbread.desc: Has an earthy taste that reminds the eater of growth cycles and rainfall percentages. Like a delicious almanac.
sliced jacksberried bookbread.name: sliced jacksberried bookbread

sliced chocolate bookbread.desc: As thick and rich as a child's bedtyme story.
sliced chocolate bookbread.name: sliced chocolate bookbread

chocolate-stuffed butterdough.desc: A mound of chocolate-speckled butterdough, yet to be elevated with the knowledge of an oven's warmth.
chocolate-stuffed butterdough.name: chocolate-stuffed butterdough

cookie.desc: Crispy, moist, sweet and savory; a sliver of ontological goodness, cradled in the palm of your hand.
cookie.name: cookie

baked slab of cookiedough.desc: The inverse to hardtack; both in reputation and taste. Just a passing whiff reminds you of home - though, perhaps it wouldn't hurt to bring out a knife and share that feeling with some friends.
baked slab of cookiedough.name: baked slab of cookiedough

oat grain.name: oat grain
oat grain.desc: Oat grains, ready to be milled and boiled.

salotack.name: salotack
salotack.desc: Thick, salted biscuits and thicker, saltier slabs of pork fat, and a sprinkling of pepper; a match made in paradise. A spicier but heartier variant of the brothbrique, its portions can be further divvied up with a knife and stewed into a remarkably hearty broth.

piece of salotack.name: piece of salotack
piece of salotack.desc: A salted cracker and a slice of pork fat, smothered in pepper. An adventurer can afford the tyme to sit down and stew this into a hearty meal; for most other soldiers-of-fortune, however, they might just have to settle with gnashing it on the go.

zizo abberation.desc: A charred fish, crisped to perfection.
zizo abberation.name: zizo abberation

cooked fish.desc: A charred fish, crisped to perfection.
cooked fish.name: cooked fish

fried spidermeat.desc: A spider leg, shaved and roasted.
fried spidermeat.name: fried spidermeat

fried shellfish.desc: Fried shellfish meat. A bit salty, but delicious.
fried shellfish.name: fried shellfish

cooked crab.desc: A cooked crab. With a sweet and rich flavor. Often laboriously made into crab cakes.
cooked crab.name: cooked crab

oyster.name: oyster
oyster.desc: A stubborn shellfish that MIGHT hide a prize within, can be opened with a knife to reveal the flesh within.

clam.name: clam
clam.desc: A beastye built by Abyssor in the image of a knight. Hard shell, squishy interior.

shrimp.name: shrimp
shrimp.desc: A tiny shellfish, little bigger than your thumb. Often nicknamed butterflies of the sea.

lobster.name: lobster
lobster.desc: A hard-shelled cretin, barely fit for eating.

raw crab cake.desc: A variant of the handpie filled with buttery, savory shellfish meat and made with a buttered slice of dough.
raw crab cake.name: raw crab cake

slice of brothbrique.desc: A melding of dried meat, berries, and tallow that has fueled Psydonia's expeditioneers for centuries. It is denser - and arguably less appetizing - than most foodstuffs, but consequently unrivaled in terms of sheer nutritional mirth. Traditionally sliced and dropped into boiling water, in order to make a quick-yet-robust broth.
slice of brothbrique.name: slice of brothbrique

lemony stickets.desc: 'At times the world may seem an unfriendly and sinister place, but believe that there is much more good in it than bad. All you have to do is look hard enough - and what might seem to be a series of unfortunate events may in fact be the first steps of a refreshingly new journey.'
lemony stickets.name: lemony stickets

wedge of aged cheese.desc: Fit for a king, or a particularly deserving mouse.
wedge of aged cheese.name: wedge of aged cheese

raw stuffed egg.desc: Raw egg stuffed with a creamy cheese filling.
raw stuffed egg.name: raw stuffed egg

spiced rosa petals.name: spiced rosa petals
spiced rosa petals.desc: A palmful of smells so delightfully rich, destined to be distilled into a damn fine cup of humor-balancing tea.

spiced coffee beans.name: spiced coffee beans
spiced coffee beans.desc: Roasted coffee beans, nestled atop a bed of fragrant pumpkin spice. It looks perfect for brewing a particularly rich kettle of coffee.

spiced tea leaves.name: spiced tea leaves
spiced tea leaves.desc: A blend of coarsely-ground tea leaves and pumpkin spice, perfect for brewing the most relaxing drinks in all of Psydonia.

spiced chocolate.name: spiced chocolate
spiced chocolate.desc: A spiced sliver of heaven, awaiting to be brewed into a velvetly rich drink.

chocolate ingot.name: chocolate ingot
chocolate ingot.desc: An unbelievably decadant slab of fudge, made with Amazonia's cocoa beans and Grenzelhoft's saiga milk. A recent trade agreement between the two nations has turned this once-expensive delicacy into a slightly-less-expensive treat for many. </br>Following a rather unfortunate diplomatic incident involving a Lupian nobleman and a box of chocolates, chocolate is also now-known to double as a potent 'humor rebalancer' for some of Dendor's children. </br>It looks like it can be split in half with a dagger.

poppy.name: poppy
poppy.desc: For their crimson beauty and the sedating effect of their crushed seeds, these flowers are considered a symbol of Eora.

chewy troll blubber.desc: Cooking it seems to have only caused the meat to toughen up. It is vile, disgusting, like partially hardened jello with greasy chunks hidden within. Perhaps it can be cooked further to stubbornly quell its spirit.
chewy troll blubber.name: chewy troll blubber

salmon.name: salmon
salmon.desc: A lonesome, horrific creacher of the freshwaters, searching for a mate. It makes for good eating.

sole.name: sole
sole.desc: An ugly flatfish, slimy and with both eyes on one side of its head. Nothing to do with feet.

plaice.name: plaice
plaice.desc: A popular flatfish for eating. Found on tables of noblefolk and peasantry alike.

cod.name: cod
cod.desc: A cod, wow! Cod you hand me another piece of bait?

uncooked tomatoplate with cheese.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes - and sprinkling of fresh cheese - upon its surface. It is ready to be baked into a delicious tomatoplate, lest one wishes to further adorn it with sausages, fillets, onions, pears, or truffles.
uncooked tomatoplate with cheese.name: uncooked tomatoplate with cheese

Butter stick.name: stick of butter
Butter stick.desc: Delicious fattiness, fit for elevating meals-a-plenty.

Stick of butter.name: stick of butter
Stick of butter.desc: Delicious fattiness, fit for elevating meals-a-plenty.

Slice of butter.name: butter
Slice of butter.desc: A portion of milky paradise. Kneading it into dough is necessary to prepare many of Psydonia's pastries, though the more humble-hearted prefer to simply doll up a slice of toast with it.

Dogroll.desc: The classic wiener in a bun, now a staple of Grenzelhoft cuisine. It is rumored that elves first invented it long ago, back when they practiced the consumption of other people...
Dogroll.name: grenzelbun

Garlic Clove.desc: A clove of garlick, fit for stewage. Don't eat this.
Garlic Clove.name: garlick clove

Rice Grains.name: rice grain
Rice Grains.desc: Rice grains, ready to be worked with water to be cleaned.

Mince.desc: Meat sliced many times both with and against the grain, producing a fine mince.
Mince.name: mince

Butter Dough.desc: What is a triumph, to a legacy?
Butter Dough.name: butterdough

Pie Dough.desc: The beginning of greater things to come.
Pie Dough.name: piedough

Fish stew.name: fish
Fish stew.desc: Fresh blood stains its silvery skin. Silver-coloured scales shimmering softly..

Antler Hood.name: antlerhood
Antler Hood.desc: A hood suited for druids and shamans.

Rollingpin.name: rolling pin
Rollingpin.desc: A wooden implement designed to flatten dough.

coffee beans.name: coffee beans
coffee beans.desc: Freshly extracted coffee beans, with a hard texture. Should be roasted first.

raw crossbun.desc: A piece of raw dough with the shape of Astrata's cross pressed onto it. In Her Light.
raw crossbun.name: raw crossbun

raw psycrossbun.desc: A piece of raw dough with the shape of a Psycross pressed onto it. He ENDURES.
raw psycrossbun.name: raw psycrossbun

uncooked dot tart with tangerines.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with delicious tangerines. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with tangerines.name: uncooked dot tart with tangerines

uncooked dot tart with plums.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with homely plums. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with plums.name: uncooked dot tart with plums

uncooked dot tart with blackberries.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with sour blackberries. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with blackberries.name: uncooked dot tart with blackberries

uncooked dot tart with raspberries.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with tart raspberries. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with raspberries.name: uncooked dot tart with raspberries

uncooked dot tart with strawberries.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with sweet strawberries. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with strawberries.name: uncooked dot tart with strawberries

uncooked dot tart with pears.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with honeyed pears. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with pears.name: uncooked dot tart with pears

uncooked dot tart with apples.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with apple slices. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with apples.name: uncooked dot tart with apples

uncooked dot tart with ambrosia.desc: A hollow bowl of butterdough, filled with a divine fruit. It merely needs a stint in the oven, now, to achieve its fullest potential.
uncooked dot tart with ambrosia.name: uncooked dot tart with ambrosia

cooked eel.desc: A cooked eel. With its rich flavor and flaky texture, it's a delicacy.
cooked eel.name: cooked eel

uncooked tomatoplate with sausages.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes, a sprinkling of fresh cheese, and a dotting of sliced sausages upon its surface. It is ready to be baked into a deliciously rich tomatoplate.
uncooked tomatoplate with sausages.name: uncooked tomatoplate with sausages

uncooked tomatoplate with truffles.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes, a sprinkling of fresh cheese, and a dotting of rare truffles upon its surface. It is ready to be baked into a deliciously decadant tomatoplate.
uncooked tomatoplate with truffles.name: uncooked tomatoplate with truffles

uncooked tomatoplate with fishes.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes, a sprinkling of fresh cheese, and a dotting of filleted fishes upon its surface. It is ready to be baked into a deliciously oiled tomatoplate.
uncooked tomatoplate with fishes.name: uncooked tomatoplate with fishes

uncooked tomatoplate with pears.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes, a sprinkling of fresh cheese, and a dotting of juicy pears upon its surface. It is ready to be baked into a deliciously creative tomatoplate.
uncooked tomatoplate with pears.name: uncooked tomatoplate with pears

uncooked tomatoplate with onions.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes, a sprinkling of fresh cheese, and a dotting of ringed onions upon its surface. It is ready to be baked into a deliciously earthsome tomatoplate.
uncooked tomatoplate with onions.name: uncooked tomatoplate with onions

fyritius flower.name: fyritius flower
fyritius flower.desc: A delicate orange flower that radiates warmth.

sunflower.name: sunflower
sunflower.desc: A large, bright yellow flower. Can be worn on the head.

westleach leaf.name: westleach leaf
westleach leaf.desc: A dried pipeweed, ready to smoke.

pepper.name: pepper
pepper.desc: Milled peppercorns, spicy as can be.

pumpkin spice.name: pumpkin spice
pumpkin spice.desc: Rich flavors from a humble origin.

fresh rosa petals.name: fresh rosa petals
fresh rosa petals.desc: Crushed rosa petals with humor-balancing properties, yearing to be further dried to draw out its flavor.

dried tea leaves.name: dried tea leaves
dried tea leaves.desc: Dried tea leaves. Edible. Seeds can be extracted from them. Needs to be processed in a millstone.

stick of jamtallow.name: stick of jamtallow
