stick of jamtallow.desc: An ingot of jammified blackberries, fit only for the finest slices of bread. It beckons to be sliced with proper cutlery.

stick of marmalade.name: stick of marmalade
stick of marmalade.desc: An ingot of jammified tangerines, fit only for the finest slices of bread. It beckons to be sliced with proper cutlery.

unfinished dough.desc: With a little more ambition, you will conquer.
unfinished dough.name: unfinished dough

sliceed ambrosia.desc: A golden apple, parted into perfectly symmetrical thirds. Opulance has never tasted so sweet!
sliceed ambrosia.name: sliceed ambrosia

uncooked tomatoplate.desc: Flatdough with a healthy smearing of sauced tomatoes upon its surface. A sprinkling of fresh cheese should round it all out.
uncooked tomatoplate.name: uncooked tomatoplate

swamp shrimp.name: swamp shrimp
swamp shrimp.desc: Swamp "Shrimp" is a small crustacean found in murky swamp waters, adapted to survive in dirty, low-oxygen water.

sunny.name: sunny
sunny.desc: A pitiful beast, clinging to Astrata's light as if it would make it stronger. Little does it know that it needs faith for such miracles.

carp.name: carp
carp.desc: A mudraking creacher of the river-depths, barely fit for food.

beaksnapper.name: beaksnapper
beaksnapper.desc: Beaksnapper is a colorful ocean fish found in salt waters, named for its strong, beak-like mouth. It is edible and prized for its firm meat, and fun fact: its snapping bite is strong enough to crush small shells, making it a clever little predator.

mudskipper.name: mudskipper
mudskipper.desc: A furtive creacher, it hides in murky waters to keep its grotesque visage secreted away.

flounder.name: flounder
flounder.desc: Flounder is a flat ocean fish living in open salt waters, well adapted to life along the seabed. It is fully edible and known for its mild, tender meat, and an interesting fact is that both of its eyes are located on one side of the body, helping it stay hidden while lying flat on the ocean floor.

swamp mother.name: swamp mother
swamp mother.desc: Swamp Mother is a large swamp-dwelling creature found in murky waters.

black-headed salmon.name: black-headed salmon
black-headed salmon.desc: Black-Headed Salmon is an ocean fish found in open salt waters, recognizable by its dark head and lighter body. It is fully edible and prized for its firm, tasty meat, and the dark coloration likely helps it blend in when hunting near the surface.

abyssal eel.name: abyssal eel
abyssal eel.desc: Pick me up pick me up pick me up pick me up pick me up pick me up!

mackerel.name: mackerel
mackerel.desc: Mackerel is a fast-moving ocean fish found in open salt waters. It is fully edible, rich in oils and flavor, and known for its speed, mackerel can swim so fast it must keep moving to breathe properly.

iridescent reaver.name: iridescent reaver
iridescent reaver.desc: Its scales refract light in a strange, unsettling manner.

black bass.name: black bass
black bass.desc: Black Bass is a freshwater fish found in clean rivers and lakes, known for its strength and aggressive behavior. It is fully edible and popular for its firm meat, and a fun fact is that black bass are notorious for fighting hard even when caught on light tackle.

clownfish.name: clownfish
clownfish.desc: This fish brings vibrant hues to this dark world.

sturgeon.name: sturgeon
sturgeon.desc: Sturgeon is a large freshwater fish found in clean rivers and waterfalls, known for its ancient appearance and heavy armor-like scales. It is fully edible and highly valued, and an interesting fact is that sturgeons have existed for over 200 million years, making them true living fossils.

steamed ham.desc: Salted cut of meat ready to be torn into further with a knife. You would be hard pressed to find this lacking in a pantry of anyone with modicum of wealth.
steamed ham.name: steamed ham

raw gnoll meat.desc: Meat taken from a gnoll. Strangely it doesn't look like it was cut out of a creature. Somehow, it seems perfectly alive.
raw gnoll meat.name: raw gnoll meat

raw rous meat.desc: A delicacy for some races, whilst others will turn up their nose at such... Sewer meat.
raw rous meat.name: raw rous meat

raw bear meat.desc: Grow some hair on yer chest lad!
raw bear meat.name: raw bear meat

strudeldough.desc: An empty shell of a greatness to come.
strudeldough.name: strudeldough

sugarshape of castle.name: sugarshape of castle
sugarshape of castle.desc: A mound of sugar, shaped into a decorative castle. It yearns to be completed beneath an oven's heat, or to be milled back down into sugarpowder.

sugarshape of arch.name: sugarshape of arch

pepperberries.name: pepperberries
pepperberries.desc: A relative to the Ferentian jackberry, stripped free of its fruity skin. Roasting it seems to've dulled its humor-imbalancing properties, though it'll still need to be milled down before it can be used for culinary matters.

roasted pumpkin seeds.name: roasted pumpkin seeds
roasted pumpkin seeds.desc: Food for birds, treats for humens.

tea leaves.name: tea leaves
tea leaves.desc: Tea leaves plucked from the plant. It is still fresh and needs to be dried before use.

ambrosia.name: ambrosia
ambrosia.desc: A golden apple, by any other name. You can see your own reflection in the golden apple's surface, as the fingers cradling it adopt a pleasant numbness.

Fish Fillet.desc: A filet of fish. All of them are the same inside.
Fish Fillet.name: fish filet

Pie(Meat).desc: A delicious, homemade pie made with minced meat. Still needs to be sliced.
Pie(Meat).name: meat pie

Aubergine.desc: Eggplant stuffed with meat and tomato. Delicious!
Aubergine.name: stuffed aubergine

unfinished tender frybird.desc: Tenderized meat, awaiting a coating of toastcrumbs and a hot oil bath.
unfinished tender frybird.name: unfinished tender frybird

unfinished squire's delight.name: unfinished squire's delight

split tomato.name: split tomato
split tomato.desc: Split halves of a plump, red fruit with juicy flesh and a balanced sweet-tart flavor. Ruptured skin cradles a deliciously silky surprise, merely a palm away from being smeared into sauce atop flatdough.

etruscan bascinet w/plume hat.name: etruscan bascinet w/plume hat

sallet w/plume hat.name: sallet w/plume hat
sallet w/plume hat.desc: A Grenzelhoftian plume hat placed atop a regular steel sallet, staying fashionable while protecting the wearer's head to a better degree.

baker's root.name: baker's root
baker's root.desc: A clean, starchy root. It can be eaten or milled into flour.

coarse salt.name: coarse salt
coarse salt.desc: Somewhat gritty, coarse salt. Could be ground down into finer salt.
